scripts.build: bun run build:ui && tsc -b && bun run bundle
scripts.bundle: bun build packages/cli/src/bin.ts --target=node --packages=bundle --outfile packages/cli/dist/bin.js && bun build packages/cli/src/agent-adapter.ts --target=node --packages=bundle --outfile packages/cli/dist/agent-adapter.js
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:ui && tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p packages/web/ui/tsconfig.json --pretty false
scripts.package:prepare: bun run build && node scripts/package.mjs prepare
scripts.package:pack: bun run build && node scripts/package.mjs pack
scripts.package:check: bun run build && bun run package:test && node scripts/package.mjs check
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint && bun run check:english
scripts.build:ui: cd packages/web/ui && bunx vite build && cd ../../.. && node scripts/embed-web-assets.mjs
